subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard add `status_changed` as a durable, replay-safe subscriber contract backed by independently retained notification records, or should this capability be deferred rather than presented as durable?
rationale: The current zero-schema projection cannot satisfy the stated durability and replay contract; choosing a persistent representation and its long-term subscriber semantics is an externally visible product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Adopt a durable event contract
options.body: Store an immutable transition notification atomically with each real status change, retain transition-time scope, and expose the new kind consistently across tools and documentation.

options.title: Keep only best-effort hints
options.body: Narrow the feature and documentation to explicitly state that recent card-history projections may be lost or reassigned after later card activity.

options.title: Defer the notification kind
options.body: Pause this contract addition until an owner selects durable retention and replay semantics for Workboard subscribers.

recommendation.title: Adopt a durable event contract
recommendation.body: Store an immutable transition notification atomically with each real status change, retain transition-time scope, and expose the new kind consistently across tools and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: A shared notification contract needs an owner decision beyond a mechanical patch repair.
